acceptance: LOAD DATA LOCAL INFILE availability recorded in context
Parity, atomicity and SF1 speed evidence recorded; fallback kept if native is not faster
Timer-boundary unit test covers the SingleStore native path
Changelog fragment states SingleStore's RF1 path
context:
LOAD DATA LOCAL INFILE availability (live, mocker 0.7.2, ghcr.io/singlestore-labs/singlestoredb-dev:latest, memsql 10.9.0, linux/amd64): server @@local_infile = ON by default. Driver singlestoredb 1.18.2: connect() without local_infile=True fails with error 1148 "LOAD DATA LOCAL is disabled by your client configuration"; with local_infile=True the load succeeds (2 rows, rowcount 2) and a trailing '|' is absorbed by an extra `@var` column-list entry, so no file staging is needed. SingleStoreAdapter._connect_database already passes local_infile=True. Mocker limits hit: `mocker compose up` of docker/singlestore fails with "Error: platform linux/arm64" (compose ignores `platform: linux/amd64`; make uat-bring-up PLATFORM=singlestore fails the same way even after `mocker pull --platform linux/amd64`), and the default 1 GiB VM makes memsql abort at start (globals.cpp:6384). Working bring-up: `mocker run -d --platform linux/amd64 -m 6g -c 4 --name benchbox-uat-manual-singlestore-singlestore-1 -p 13306:3306 -e ROOT_PASSWORD=benchbox ghcr.io/singlestore-labs/singlestoredb-dev:latest`.

Evidence (live, SingleStore 10.9.0 dev image linux/amd64 on mocker, 4 GiB): (1) per-column checksum parity native vs VALUES at SF0.01 (orders and lineitem after RF1, sha256 over every column ordered by all columns, plus row counts): PASS (tests/integration/platforms/test_singlestore_live.py::TestLiveSingleStoreTPCHRefreshIngest::test_native_rf1_matches_values_path_for_every_column). (2) Atomicity: injected non-numeric lineitem DECIMAL aborts, rolls back, table checksums equal pre-RF1 state, connection usable: PASS. Finding: SingleStore LOAD DATA silently loads non-numeric DECIMAL text as 0.00 even with STRICT_ALL_TABLES (INT, DATE and CHAR length overflow are rejected), so the first implementation failed the atomicity test; fixed by loading DECIMAL columns into @vars and SET col = IF(@col REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$', @col, 1e30), which makes the server raise 1264 out of range. dbgen refresh files and base files have no trailing '|'; a trailing '|' errors 1262. (3) RF1 SF1 (orders 1,500,000 / lineitem 6,001,215 base, three update sets of ~7.3-7.6k rows, same set undone between native and VALUES, real adapter schema with shard/sort keys): native 0.104/0.035/0.032 s, VALUES 0.319/0.188/0.177 s; best of three native 0.032 s vs VALUES 0.177 s (5.5x). Final path: native.

Resumption: claim released while PR #3979 (branch feat/singlestore-rf1-native-ingest, worktree ../BenchBox.wt-singlestore-rf1) is in CI. A first CI run failed only on three unrelated tests/unit/test_heavy_choke_points.py cases; make pr-rerun was issued. Re-take and finish after merge.
